title: THE BOTTLE | She Waited Till Dark
description:
He only wanted one drink before picking up his daughter. The first one was free. Every glass after that cost him something he slid across the bar himself.

THE BOTTLE | She Waited Till Dark is an animated short film about the habit that takes the people you love one drink at a time, and the night a father finally ran back.

Who is still waiting for you? Tell me in the comments.

#shortfilm #animation #horror #selfimprovement #alcohol
